# Temporary compatibility guard for the scheduled upgrade matrix.
# MCP 2.2.0 adds an explicit authorization-server issuer requirement that
# FastMCP's client-credentials wrapper does not yet expose. Keep the upgrade
# matrix below 2.2.0 until that API is wired through; do not weaken runtime
# credential-routing semantics just to silence the warning.
mcp<2.2.0

# ty 0.0.79 newly reports two redundant-condition diagnostics as failures in
# existing code. Keep scheduled upgrade checks on the last compatible release
# until those diagnostics are fixed without changing runtime behavior.
ty<0.0.79
